name: Marvel Legends Chronicle API
for_agents: Start at data/v1/index.json. For task procedures, read skills/index.json and load the relevant skill file — skills are the primary agentic interface for doing work, the JSON endpoints are the data layer. The full agent guide is AGENT.md at the repository root.
provenance: Fan-compiled archive. Within-year ordering is year-accurate but not audited to the month; some BAF pieces and disputed wave numbers are flagged in notes.

skills.usage: Each skill is a markdown file with frontmatter (name, description), then: Use when, Inputs, Procedure, Worked example, Data/API references, Pitfalls. Agent-playbook skills (skills/agents/) use an 'API references' section pointing at data/v1 endpoints; the rest use 'Data references' pointing at data/*.json. Load the skill whose task matches the user's request.

index.description: Self-describing manifest: every endpoint with path, description, schema URLs, ISO-8601 UTC updated timestamp, record counts, and deprecation notes. Start here.

stats.description: Archive totals: wave/figure counts, year range, BAF/exclusive/variant tallies, per-year and per-manufacturer breakdowns. Cheapest entry point for overview questions.

waves.description: One summary per wave: id, year, manufacturer, series, BAF name (nullable), story source (nullable), figure count.

figures.description: Flat list of every figure with wave context and stable ids (<waveId>::<figureName>). Filter client-side by year, manufacturer, waveId, exclusive, variant, bafPiece.

encyclopedia.description: Collector encyclopedia: line history, packaging evolution, variant/chase/exclusive taxonomy, hall of fame (with reissue-radar flags), grading guide, transparent price methodology, bootleg-spotting guide, resources directory. Editorial knowledge, not catalog data.

preorders.description: Researched upcoming releases: status (preorder/revealed/available), exact preorderDate (YYYY-MM-DD, null when unreported — never invented), releaseWindow, announced MSRP (never a market price), retailer search patterns, hobby-press sources.

characters.description: Character guides: every character with a dedicated page — slug, display name, release count, first/last year, and the page path. Join to figures.json by character name for shelf audits.

timeline.description: The Legends Timeline: year-by-year line history 2002-2026 — era, headline, summary, sourced milestones, packaging notes, per-year wave records (ids link into the archive), and spotlight figure ids.

rarity.description: The Rarity Guide: chase vs variant vs exclusive vs limited — tier definitions with sourced examples (real figure ids), how-to-spot notes, value notes (reported prices only), archive signal counts, and the quest-achievement mapping. Generated by scripts/build_rarity.py.

price-signals.description: Reported market price signals for the Price Watch: curated, sourced sold-band / sold-avg / listing / claimed prices already published on the Chronicle (encyclopedia, market briefing) — reported ranges, not live prices; the Chronicle publishes no price index.

launch-curves.description: The Launch Curve: real sold-price timelines for newly launched figures — every point a reported eBay sold/presale from a named hobby tracker, with sellout event markers and MSRP. Documents the sellout → spike → cool → retail pattern; reported timelines, not predictions. Generated by scripts/build_launch.py.

drop-week.description: Drop Week Command Center: the Oct 14 → Nov 1 drop sequence + Nov 20 made-to-order deadline — confirmed drop windows, lineups with researched accessory notes, announced prices, ship windows, scarcity/price/KO intel, and rumor watch (flagged uncertain). Editorial payload generated by scripts/build_dropweek.py from data/drop-week.json.

radar-candidates.description: Hand-maintained reissue-radar research feed: newly spotted news items (title, URL, source, detection time). Research notes, not a generated snapshot.
radar-candidates.notes: Hand-maintained — build_api.py reads it for the record count but never rewrites it.

radar-seen.description: Hand-maintained dedupe list of radar URLs already processed. Array of URL strings.
radar-seen.notes: Hand-maintained — build_api.py reads it for the record count but never rewrites it.

compare.description: VS-mode figure profiles: one per archive figure — stable `deepLink` (waves/<waveId>.html#fig-<slug>), shareable `compareUrl` (compare.html?a=<id>), `rarity` tier cross-ref, `priceSignals` (reported ranges, never live prices), `koWatch` note, and `upgradePaths` (documented other releases of the same character). Powers the Figure Compare page; derived from committed data by scripts/compare_lib.py.

year-review.description: 2026: The State of Legends — the year-in-review: scored Top-10 2026 releases (transparent distinction criteria), 2026 archive stats, reported-price movement math (reported solds only, never an index), best-value picks from announced MSRPs, KO watch, rarity highlights, and honest data gaps. Generated by scripts/build_review.py.

quest-market.description: Quest-market intel: the 2026 Market Briefing's published numbers as machine-readable data for the Grail Quest — 2026 MSRP tiers (standard $27.99, deluxe $34.99–$46.99, Miles mask $139.99), the dead-modern-chase era (white Doom $115–$200 reported band), the reissue program's sellout → spike → reissue → collapse pattern, KO watch, and the Doomsday Wave 1 launch-curve cooling. Reported listings/solds only — never an index. Generated by scripts/build_quest_market.py from data/quest-market.json.
